faq.title: Everything you wanted to ask, answered

items.question: How long does a typical website take?
items.answer: A focused marketing website usually takes 3 to 6 weeks from kickoff to launch. Larger web apps are scoped in phases so you see working software early.

items.question: Do you handle hosting and deployment?
items.answer: Yes. We set up your domain, SSL, hosting and CI/CD pipeline, then hand over full documentation. We can also keep managing it for you.

items.question: Can my website support multiple languages?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our sites ship with proper localisation, including translated routes, hreflang tags and per-language SEO, ready for English, Bahasa Melayu and more.

items.question: Will I be able to edit the content myself?
items.answer: That's the plan. We integrate a headless CMS or an admin dashboard that fits your team, and train you to use it.

items.question: What do you need from me to get started?
items.answer: Just a short brief: your goals, audience, any brand assets and examples you like. We'll guide you through the rest in a discovery call.

items.question: How do I know if my project is simple, moderate or complex?
items.answer: Simple projects have a few pages or one data source. Moderate projects add a CMS, several languages or multiple data sources and user roles. Complex projects involve custom features, accounts, payments, integrations or large volumes of data. We confirm the level and a fixed quote in your free consultation.

items.question: Do you work with businesses in Singapore and Hong Kong?
items.answer: Yes. We work remotely with SMEs and startups across Malaysia, Singapore and Hong Kong. Calls are held in your local time, and you are billed in your local currency.

items.question: Why do prices differ between countries?
items.answer: Prices reflect local market rates and billing currency. The scope, quality and process are the same in every market.

items.question: How are projects billed?
items.answer: Typically 40% to start, 40% at design sign-off and 20% on launch. Larger projects are billed by milestone.

items.question: What is not included in the package price?
items.answer: Domain registration, third-party licences and paid hosting tiers are billed at cost, and applicable taxes are added. We will flag these during planning.

items.question: Can I upgrade later?
items.answer: Yes. Start with a simple scope and move up to moderate or complex later. We design the foundations so you never have to rebuild.

items.question: What happens after launch?
items.answer: Every level includes a support period (2 weeks, 3 months or 6 months). If you want ongoing help afterwards, we can agree a monthly support arrangement during your consultation.
